about.title: About SunSet Tours Egypt
about.p1: We design coastal itineraries across Egypt’s Red Sea with a focus on clarity: honest pricing, bilingual storytelling, and responsive support.
about.p2: Our team blends local insight with a premium, minimal aesthetic — so planning feels calm, not chaotic.
about.p3: Whether you crave Sharm’s energy, Hurghada’s variety, or Marsa Alam’s serenity, we help you land on the right package.
